title: The Pollinator Covenant
logline: An itinerant circuit ship captain discovers their flight partner plans to sell their clan's proprietary crop cross-pollination cultures to a corporate habitat syndicate.

roles.description: Master of an independent cross-pollination runner; weary, fiercely loyal to clan tradition and ancestral germplasm.
Chief botanist of the runner; exhausted by nomad poverty and negotiating a permanent corporate residency.
The commercial agribusiness managing the system's industrial aeroponic towers.
A high-yield aeroponic citadel where food contracts are signed and commercial harvests processed.
A low-rent exterior mooring where independent transit ships dock between agricultural runs.

public_situation: The circuit runner docked at {role:circuit_berth} is locked down by corporate bailiffs over an alleged breach of an ancient intersystem pollination covenant.
private_truth: The runner's botanist is secretly auctioning the clan's unpatented cross-pollination spore cultures to buy residency in {role:syndicate_dome}.

beats.public_change: Bailiff cutters post mooring clamps around {role:circuit_berth} while aeroponic dome feeds log emergency spore shortages.

missions.reason: He needs an outsider to scan the runner's airlock telemetry to determine who accessed the refrigerated germplasm vault before dawn.
missions.private_fact: He suspects his lifelong flight partner took the canister but refuses to confront her without data.

beats.public_change: Commercial tenders begin transferring nitrogen dewars to {role:syndicate_dome} as the botanist moves toward the executive suites.

missions.reason: She hires a neutral pilot to ferry the insulated spore canister to the commercial dome before her captain overrides the ship lock.
missions.private_fact: She suffers from degenerative vacuum osteopenia and cannot survive another five-year circuit run.

beats.public_change: Armed syndicate security details take positions at the airlocks of {role:syndicate_dome} to finalize the spore purchase.

missions.reason: He asks the pilot to courier an ancestral covenant notice directly to syndicate directors to assert prior clan ownership.
missions.private_fact: The clan covenant has no legal force under station commercial law without physical possession of the spores.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot holds the master spore canister. The captain demands its return to the clan runner; the botanist needs the sale to secure life-saving habitat residency.

options.label: Return the canister to the captain to preserve the clan's nomadic pollination legacy
Deliver the canister to the corporate syndicate to buy the botanist's medical residency
Compel both partners to license the spores for one harvest cycle, splitting the payout

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot returns the spore canister to the captain and helps the runner break mooring.
resolutions.summary: {role:itinerant_captain} recovers the ancestral cultures and clears the system. {role:renegade_partner} is left behind on the docks without medical care.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot defied corporate bailiffs to return stolen crop cultures to a wandering seed runner.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the spore canister to the corporate syndicate.
resolutions.summary: {role:agro_syndicate} patents the hardy pollination cultures. {role:renegade_partner} receives station residency, while {role:itinerant_captain} leaves impoverished.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot brokers a single-season propagation lease between the partners and the syndicate.
resolutions.summary: The syndicate pays for a single crop pollination. Both crewmates divide the proceeds, dissolving their partnership with bitter civility.

resolutions.reached_by: The telemetry is lost or the pilot abandons the contract.
resolutions.summary: Syndicate marshals confiscate the spore canister under civil impound warrants. The clan runner is expelled from the system without compensation.

loose_threads.detail: The residency permit promised to the runner botanist was pre-approved by syndicate HR three weeks before the ship arrived.
The spore vault's digital latch log shows forty-two bypass attempts using an encryption key issued by a debt agency.
Station commodity exchanges opened advance futures trading on clan-exclusive fruit strains before the vault was breached.

radio_hooks: Mooring bailiffs impound itinerant agricultural transport over disputed pollination covenants.
{role:agro_syndicate} announces imminent yield breakthroughs in high-density aeroponic fruit towers.
Independent circuit runners protest outside customs against arbitrary biological impounds.

voice_direction.itinerant_captain: Tired, gravelly, and formal. Speaks of his crop cultures with genealogical reverence and avoids admitting his crew is splintering.
voice_direction.renegade_partner: Hushed, clinical, and defensive. Speaks in rapid biological jargon to conceal her physical weakness and terror of dying in deep space.
